en: And seek help through patience and prayer, and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allah]
ar: وَٱسۡتَعِينُواْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِۚ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلۡخَٰشِعِينَ

nb.en: Do you order righteousness of the people and forget yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason?

en: Say, "Allah is most knowing of how long they remained. He has [knowledge of] the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. How Seeing is He and how Hearing! They have not besides Him any protector, and He shares not His legislation with anyone."
ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثُواْۖ لَهُۥ غَيۡبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ أَبۡصِرۡ بِهِۦ وَأَسۡمِعۡۚ مَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا يُشۡرِكُ فِي حُكۡمِهِۦٓ أَحَدٗا

nb.en: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine.

en: And they came to their father at night, weeping.
ar: وَجَآءُوٓ أَبَاهُمۡ عِشَآءٗ يَبۡكُونَ

nb.en: So when they took him [out] and agreed to put him into the bottom of the well... But We inspired to him, "You will surely inform them [someday] about this affair of theirs while they do not perceive [your identity]."

en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ar: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

nb.en: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.

en: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."
ar: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنۡ ءَالِهَتِي يَـٰٓإِبۡرَٰهِيمُۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ لَأَرۡجُمَنَّكَۖ وَٱهۡجُرۡنِي مَلِيّٗا

nb.en: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."

en: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.
ar: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَنزِيلٗا

nb.en: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

en: By the sky and the night comer -
ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ

nb.en: And what can make you know what is the night comer?

en: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,
ar: مَّنَّاعٖ لِّلۡخَيۡرِ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

nb.en: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -

en: There shall be no compulsion in [acceptance of] the religion. The right course has become clear from the wrong. So whoever disbelieves in Taghut and believes in Allah has grasped the most trustworthy handhold with no break in it. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
ar: لَآ إِكۡرَاهَ فِي ٱلدِّينِۖ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ ٱلرُّشۡدُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيِّۚ فَمَن يَكۡفُرۡ بِٱلطَّـٰغُوتِ وَيُؤۡمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدِ ٱسۡتَمۡسَكَ بِٱلۡعُرۡوَةِ ٱلۡوُثۡقَىٰ لَا ٱنفِصَامَ لَهَاۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

nb.en: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

en: Thus. And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge.
ar: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَقَدۡ أَحَطۡنَا بِمَا لَدَيۡهِ خُبۡرٗا

nb.en: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had not made against it any shield.

en: On adorned couches, observing.
ar: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ

nb.en: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,

en: And have you seen the water that you drink?
ar: أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱلۡمَآءَ ٱلَّذِي تَشۡرَبُونَ

nb.en: Rather, we have been deprived."

en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?
ar: قُلۡ هَلۡ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِٱلۡأَخۡسَرِينَ أَعۡمَٰلًا

nb.en: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.

en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ar: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ

nb.en: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.

en: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
ar: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ

nb.en: And never therefrom will they be absent.

en: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
ar: وَخَلَقَ ٱلۡجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٖ مِّن نَّارٖ

nb.en: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.

en: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.
ar: ۞إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأۡمُرُ بِٱلۡعَدۡلِ وَٱلۡإِحۡسَٰنِ وَإِيتَآيِٕ ذِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَيَنۡهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَٱلۡمُنكَرِ وَٱلۡبَغۡيِۚ يَعِظُكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُونَ

nb.en: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves. And We will bring you, [O Muhammad], as a witness over your nation. And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims.

en: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
ar: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

nb.en: And fruits from whatever they desire,

en: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
ar: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيهَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٖۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيمٌ

nb.en: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"

en: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy."
ar: وَأَعۡتَزِلُكُمۡ وَمَا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدۡعُواْ رَبِّي عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّي شَقِيّٗا

nb.en: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.

en: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
ar: وَلَحۡمِ طَيۡرٖ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ

nb.en: And fruit of what they select

en: And she certainly determined [to seduce] him, and he would have inclined to her had he not seen the proof of his Lord. And thus [it was] that We should avert from him evil and immorality. Indeed, he was of Our chosen servants.
ar: وَلَقَدۡ هَمَّتۡ بِهِۦۖ وَهَمَّ بِهَا لَوۡلَآ أَن رَّءَا بُرۡهَٰنَ رَبِّهِۦۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنَصۡرِفَ عَنۡهُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَٱلۡفَحۡشَآءَۚ إِنَّهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ

nb.en: And she, in whose house he was, sought to seduce him. She closed the doors and said, "Come, you." He said, "[I seek] the refuge of Allah. Indeed, he is my master, who has made good my residence. Indeed, wrongdoers will not succeed."

en: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
ar: قَالَ إِنِّي عَبۡدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِيَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيّٗا

nb.en: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"

en: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحٗا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ

nb.en: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -

en: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
ar: إِيَّاكَ نَعۡبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسۡتَعِينُ

nb.en: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.

en: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
ar: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُواْ جَنَّةٗ وَحَرِيرٗا

nb.en: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

en: As for he who thinks himself without need,
ar: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰ

nb.en: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?

en: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
ar: رَفَعَ سَمۡكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا

nb.en: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.

en: Those who make show [of their deeds]
ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ يُرَآءُونَ

nb.en: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -

en: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.
ar: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ

nb.en: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,

en: And those within whose wealth is a known right
ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِيٓ أَمۡوَٰلِهِمۡ حَقّٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ

nb.en: Those who are constant in their prayer

en: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.
ar: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَٰغِينَ

nb.en: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.

en: Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [Allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allah to grant him] peace.
ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتَهُۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِيِّۚ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ صَلُّواْ عَلَيۡهِ وَسَلِّمُواْ تَسۡلِيمًا

nb.en: There is no blame upon women concerning their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their brothers' sons or their sisters' sons or their women or those their right hands possess. And fear Allah. Indeed Allah is ever, over all things, Witness.

en: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
ar: يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ

nb.en: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.

en: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not tell you that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
ar: ۞قَالَ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسۡتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرٗا

nb.en: So they set out, until when they met a boy, al-Khidh r killed him. [Moses] said, "Have you killed a pure soul for other than [having killed] a soul? You have certainly done a deplorable thing."

en: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
ar: إِذۡ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى

nb.en: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -

en: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
ar: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ

nb.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

en: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
ar: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارٗا

nb.en: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

en: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
ar: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ أَيۡدِينَآ أَنۡعَٰمٗا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ

nb.en: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.

en: Which had weighed upon your back
ar: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهۡرَكَ

nb.en: And We removed from you your burden
